page_title: MAI 2-0 PAU | Mainz v St. Pauli 22/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' 2 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Jae-Sung Lee plays it into the box, and Paul Nebel (Mainz) gets on the end of the cross to put it low into the middle of the net. 2:0.
90+4' David Nemeth (St. Pauli) receives a yellow card for infringement.
90+3' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Armindo Sieb (Mainz) heads on.
90+2' St. Pauli can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
87' Paul Nebel (Mainz) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
87' St. Pauli quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
86' Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
83' Mainz have been awarded a corner kick.
83' Here comes a substitution. Silvan Widmer (Mainz) is brought on as a substitute for Phillipp Mwene.
83' Johannes Eggestein (St. Pauli) gets inside the box and only has the keeper to beat, but smashes his shot just inches past the right post. He should have scored!
82' Peter Nemeth has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Abdoulie Ceesay (St. Pauli) replacing Philipp Treu.
82' A substitution has been made. Noah Weisshaupt is replaced by Danel Sinani (St. Pauli).
80' Armindo Sieb (Mainz) slips past a defender on the edge of the box and hits a shot at goal that rises just over the bar.
79' Jackson Irvine (St. Pauli) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header flies yards over the crossbar.
77' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Mainz comes to nothing.
77' The Mainz players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
74' Wonderful movement by St. Pauli. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
73' A substitution has been made. Jonathan Burkardt goes off and Armindo Sieb (Mainz) comes on.
72' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) commits a rough challenge and Felix Zwayer blows his whistle for an infringement. St. Pauli are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
71' Mainz control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
69' The ball goes out of play and Mainz have been awarded a corner kick.
68' Here is a change. Elias Saad is going off and Peter Nemeth gives the last tactical orders to Oladapo Afolayan (St. Pauli).
67' 1 - 0 Goal! Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the right side of the goal. It's 1:0.
66' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Dominik Kohr departs the field of play to be replaced by Andreas Hanche-Olsen (Mainz).
65' Siebe Van Der Heyden (St. Pauli) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
65' Mainz hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
64' Mainz are ruled offside.
62' Peter Nemeth is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Lars Ritzka (St. Pauli) suffers an injury and Adam Dzwigala comes on.
61' The game is interrupted now, Lars Ritzka (St. Pauli) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
60' A great solo run by Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) took him deep inside the box, but his weak effort towards the left side of the goal was easily caught by Nikola Vasilj.
60' Mainz keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
59' One of the players from Mainz times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
56' Mainz force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
54' Jackson Irvine (St. Pauli) blows a huge opportunity! He latches on to a perfect cross from the wing into the penalty area, but sends his bullet header just wide of the right post.
53' St. Pauli are awarded a penalty! What an opportunity to score.
52' It's going to be a corner kick.
52' The referee points to the corner flag and St. Pauli will take a corner.
50' Yellow card! It's like Dominik Kohr (Mainz) was asking for a caution with his behaviour. Felix Zwayer agrees and books him.
49' The St. Pauli players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
48' Paul Nebel (Mainz) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
47' Elias Saad (St. Pauli) trips an opposition player and Felix Zwayer signals a foul.
46' Bo Henriksen makes a switch. Jae-Sung Lee is coming on in place of Nelson Weiper (Mainz) at the start of the second period.
46' Referee Felix Zwayer blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
44' Mainz are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
43' Philipp Treu (St. Pauli) has a great chance on the edge of the six-yard box following a lofted pass, but his header lacks accuracy and flies just past the right post.
39' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Mainz.
37' The shot by Nelson Weiper (Mainz) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Nikola Vasilj.
37' There's an opportunity for Eric Smith (St. Pauli) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
35' Elias Saad (St. Pauli) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
34' Some neat passing and movement from Mainz as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
32' Noah Weisshaupt (St. Pauli) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
31' Mainz seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
29' Mainz are playing excellent possession football at the moment by exchanging some long passes.
28' St. Pauli enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
26' Noah Weisshaupt (St. Pauli) lacks options so fires a shot at goal from the edge of box, but it's a wasted effort and goes high over the bar.
25' It’s the correct decision – NO PENALTY for St. Pauli! VAR comes to the rescue of referee Felix Zwayer and both teams have no complaints.

24' Play continues despite the shouts by some St. Pauli players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Felix Zwayer interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
24' A player from Mainz pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle. A penalty is awarded to St. Pauli!
24' Philipp Treu (St. Pauli) picks up a yellow card.
21' Moritz Jenz (Mainz) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Felix Zwayer blows his whistle for an infringement.
19' St. Pauli take a quick free kick and immediately restart play.
18' Kaishu Sano (Mainz) is cautioned by the referee, who shows him a yellow card.
15' Now St. Pauli have a corner.
15' Johannes Eggestein (St. Pauli) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Robin Zentner pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
13' The Mainz players are exchanging some short passes.
11' St. Pauli are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.

8' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Mainz are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
7' Noah Weisshaupt (St. Pauli) fires a shot from close range, but he is somehow only able to hit the left post!
7' Mainz have been awarded a corner kick.
3' Eric Smith (St. Pauli) fails to convert the free kick from the edge of the box. He sends the ball way wide of the right, not even getting close to finding the target.
2' A player from Mainz brings down an opponent and commits a foul. St. Pauli earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Felix Zwayer will supervise the game today.
